title: Core identities and sales scope
summary: Who buys, what is sold, and which customer-specific relationship refines the generic master data.

entities.title: Business Partner / Customer
entities.memory_hook: One business partner, many commercial personalities.
entities.business_question: Who buys, receives, gets billed, pays, and which sales-area rules should follow that party?
entities.scope: S/4HANA Business Partner is the central identity. Sales behavior is still scoped by customer role and sales area, while logistics and accounting consume customer-specific views.
key_dimensions: company code where accounting data is relevant

high_value_attributes.name: partner functions
high_value_attributes.why: Sold-to, ship-to, bill-to and payer can be different parties and drive different downstream context.

high_value_attributes.name: customer pricing procedure
high_value_attributes.why: Participates in pricing-procedure determination.

high_value_attributes.name: shipping condition
high_value_attributes.why: Participates in shipping-point and route-related logic.

high_value_attributes.name: delivering plant / shipping defaults
high_value_attributes.why: Can influence fulfillment proposals; address-dependent variants matter in modern multiple-address handling.

high_value_attributes.name: payment terms and Incoterms
high_value_attributes.why: Flow into commercial and billing context.

high_value_attributes.name: tax classification
high_value_attributes.why: Participates in tax determination.

high_value_attributes.name: account assignment group
high_value_attributes.why: Participates in revenue account determination.

high_value_attributes.name: delivery priority / partial-delivery controls
high_value_attributes.why: Influence fulfillment behavior and order handling.

high_value_attributes.name: sales office / sales group
high_value_attributes.why: Useful for responsibility and analytics, not usually the first place to debug core fulfillment.

precedence: General BP data is global; customer sales data is sales-area-specific.
A partner role can change which party supplies a downstream attribute; do not assume sold-to owns every value.
Address-dependent customer data can alter fields such as Incoterms, shipping condition, delivering plant, tax classification, and partner descriptions where the feature is active.

maintenance.note: In S/4HANA the BP approach is central; classic customer tables remain important technical read models in many on-premise/private-cloud scenarios.

notes: Treat table names as technical orientation, not a public-cloud integration contract.

failure_signals: sales area missing for an otherwise valid BP
output sent to the wrong partner
credit check uses an unexpected account
lead_questions: Which partner function owns the value I am debugging?
Is the value global, company-code-specific, sales-area-specific, or address-dependent?
Was it copied into the document or redetermined?

relations.why: partner relationships and functions are a master-data input
customer pricing procedure and commercial attributes participate in pricing
recipient and communication context depend on partners
customer texts can be copied into sales documents

entities.title: Product / Material
entities.memory_hook: The product master is where a harmless code quietly becomes process behavior.
entities.business_question: What is being sold, and which sales/logistics attributes make this product behave the way it does?
entities.scope: Product data spans global, distribution-chain, plant and unit-of-measure views. Sales often reads only a few fields, but those fields can have a very large blast radius.

high_value_attributes.name: item category group
high_value_attributes.why: Combines with sales-document context to determine item behavior.

high_value_attributes.name: supplying / delivering plant
high_value_attributes.why: Feeds fulfillment and downstream shipping context.

high_value_attributes.name: loading group
high_value_attributes.why: Combines with shipping condition and plant in shipping-point determination.

high_value_attributes.name: availability check
high_value_attributes.why: Controls how the material participates in availability logic at plant level.

high_value_attributes.name: sales unit / alternative UoM
high_value_attributes.why: Changes quantity interpretation, pricing keys and delivery handling.

high_value_attributes.name: product pricing group
high_value_attributes.why: Can be a condition key in pricing.

high_value_attributes.name: account assignment product group
high_value_attributes.why: Can participate in revenue account determination.

high_value_attributes.name: product hierarchy
high_value_attributes.why: Supports pricing and analytical grouping.

high_value_attributes.name: sales status and validity
high_value_attributes.why: Can restrict selling within a distribution chain and time window.

high_value_attributes.name: minimum order / delivery quantity and delivery unit
high_value_attributes.why: Shape quantity acceptance and delivery rounding.

precedence: Global product data is not the same as sales-organization/distribution-channel data or plant data.
Customer-material data can provide a more specific customer/product view for selected fields.
Material determination can substitute the requested product, after which item/availability behavior may need to be understood for the resulting product.

maintenance.note: Fiori/API interfaces vary by deployment; classic transactions remain useful orientation for private-cloud/on-premise systems.

notes: Use released views/APIs for integrations where available; direct-table thinking is an implementation diagnostic, not the architecture contract.

failure_signals: price access misses a product key
delivery quantity is rounded or rejected unexpectedly
lead_questions: Which product view owns the field: global, sales, plant or UoM?
Is the product still the one originally entered, or was it substituted?
Which downstream mechanism consumes this field?

relations.why: item category group is a primary input
product and customer context can propose plant
loading group contributes to shipping-point determination
plant/product availability settings shape ATP context
product groups/hierarchies and unit context can enter condition keys
product sales texts can be copied

entities.title: Customer Material
entities.memory_hook: When customer and product disagree with the generic defaults, KNMT gets a vote.
entities.business_question: Does this customer have its own name, logistics defaults, or text for this product?
entities.scope: A customer-material record specializes the relationship between one customer and one product within Sales. It is not a replacement for either master object; it is the intersection.

high_value_attributes.name: customer material number
high_value_attributes.why: Lets the customer identify the product using its own external number.

high_value_attributes.name: customer description / references
high_value_attributes.why: Supports customer-facing order entry and communication.

high_value_attributes.name: shipping and partial-delivery data
high_value_attributes.why: Can refine logistics behavior for the customer/product relationship.

high_value_attributes.name: delivering plant in address-dependent scenarios
high_value_attributes.why: Can make the same customer/product relationship behave differently by address.

high_value_attributes.name: long text
high_value_attributes.why: Provides customer-specific product text that can flow into sales documents.

precedence: Think of this object as a more specific customer × product layer, not a duplicate material master.
Where SAP supports a customer-material-specific value, it can refine the generic customer/product context; exact field precedence should be proven for the target process.
Address-dependent variants add another specificity level where multiple-address handling is active.

maintenance.note: SAP migration documentation explicitly identifies KNMT and VD52/VD53 for customer material data.

notes: I_CustomerMaterial_2 is a current released CDS successor for customer-material retrieval in public-cloud documentation.

failure_signals: customer enters its own material number but lookup fails
generic material behavior works for other customers but not this one
lead_questions: Is the defect generic to the product or specific to one customer/product pair?

relations.why: customer-product specificity can refine generic customer defaults for supported attributes
customer-product specificity can refine generic product-facing values for supported attributes
customer-material text can be a text source

entities.title: Customer Sales Partner Functions
entities.memory_hook: The customer record says who exists; partner relationships say who plays which role.
entities.business_question: For this customer and sales area, which partner should become ship-to, bill-to, payer, contact, or another role?
entities.scope: Partner-function relationships are maintained in customer sales data and consumed by partner determination. They are relationship data, not merely a list displayed in the sales order.
key_dimensions: partner counter where multiple partners exist

high_value_attributes.name: partner function
high_value_attributes.why: Defines the semantic role of the related partner.

high_value_attributes.name: partner customer / BP
high_value_attributes.why: Provides the actual party that can be copied into the document.

high_value_attributes.name: default / uniqueness context
high_value_attributes.why: Matters when several partners are possible for the same role.

precedence: The partner determination procedure controls which functions are allowed/mandatory and how they are sourced.
Master relationships provide candidate partners; configuration controls document behavior.
Item-level partner logic can differ from header logic where configured.

maintenance.note: Maintain in the customer sales-area context.

failure_signals: route/billing context changes when partner changes
lead_questions: Is the wrong partner coming from master relationship or from partner-procedure logic?
Which partner role supplies the downstream attribute?
Are several valid partners available and is user selection expected?

relations.why: stores role relationships for a customer sales context
master relationship is an input to document partner determination
